children: According to CNBC, Jim Cramer’s Charitable Trust bought shares of Advanced Micro Devices, FedEx Freight, Meta Platforms, Constellation Brands and Bank of New York during Wall Street’s worst week in more than a year. The S&P 500 fell 8.6% for the week, while the Nasdaq dropped 10%. The trust also completed a planned swap, selling Intel at an approximately 50% loss to start a position in AMD, and trimmed Apple after its 31% rally this year. It upgraded Meta to a buy-equivalent 1 rating after adding to the position.

title: Jim Cramer Put Money to Work During Wall Street’s Worst Week in Over a Year
